name: Chem Live Resin All-in-One | 1g
description: Chem is a strain featuring dominant terpenes—a unique blend—delivering a bold, terpene-rich flavor profile. Crafted with proprietary zero heat solvent removal process, this formulation is 100% Live resin. This All-in-One device is built for a smooth, full-bodied live resin experience: flavor-forward, satisfying, and consistent from the first pull to the last. Designed for real-life convenience, it’s pre-charged and ready to use, making it an easy go-to for elevated, on-the-go sessions. Enjoy Chem with Dabstract’s Live Resin All-in-One Device.
